name: The Harpers
description: Loosely linked cells that oppose tyranny. Sister Garaele is a member. They've taken an interest in the party after the goblins, the lost mine and the creature beneath the manor.

name: Lords' Alliance
description: Sent Sildar to meet Iarno. Sildar is asking it to aid Phandalin.

name: The Rockseeker brothers
description: Gundren, Nundro and the late Tharden. They rediscovered Wave Echo Cave and owe the party 10% of its profits.

name: The Spider's network
description: Nezznar's operation directed the Cragmaws and Redbrands to claim the Forge of Spells. Someone else inside it took an interest in Vexhar.

name: Cragmaw goblins
description: Klarg reported to King Grol, who answered to the Spider. Both are dead.

name: Redbrands
description: Red-cloaked ruffians who ran protection rackets in Phandalin under Glasstaff. Their cloaks kept the crypt skeletons from attacking.

name: Scraptops
description: Scavengers and tinkerers, and home to Droop and Craig.

name: Lion's Shield Coster
description: Its blue lion sigil was on the stolen crates.

name: Townsfolk of Phandalin
description: Free drinks, a manor deed, and a man at the bar who thanked them for dealing with the Redbrands.

name: The traveling festival
description: Red and cream wagons and a striped tent. It arrived at dusk in session 37. Its tug of war crew had not lost in seven towns until Phandalin beat them.
